SECRET_KEY.description: Encryption key for stored credentials. Auto-generated during install.

GENERIC_TIMEZONE.description: Timezone for workflow scheduling and date display (e.g. America/New_York).

N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encryption key for stored credentials. Auto-generated during install.

N8N_SECURE_COOKIE.description: Require HTTPS for authentication cookies. Disabled for local access.

N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED.description: Send anonymous usage statistics to n8n. Disabled for privacy.

N8N_PERSONALIZATION_ENABLED.description: Show personalization survey on first login. Disabled for simpler setup.

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Public URL for webhook triggers. Auto-configured from mDNS hostname when available.
